function.name: execute_sql
function.description: Execute a SQL SELECT query against the MySQL database and return results.

query.description: The SQL query to execute. Must be a SELECT statement.

explanation.description: A brief human-readable explanation of what this query does.

function.name: explain_query
function.description: Estimate the cost of a SELECT query without running it. Returns the optimizer's cost, how many rows would be examined, and whether a full table scan occurs. Use this before running a query you suspect may be slow or scan a large table.

query.description: The SELECT query to analyse. It is not executed.

function.name: get_schema
function.description: Get the full database schema including all tables and columns.

function.name: get_table_lineage
function.description: Get lineage/dependency graph for a table/view or all.

table_name.description: The table or view name. Use all for full lineage.

function.name: describe_table
function.description: Get detailed description and sample rows for a table.

function.name: check_data_quality
function.description: Run data quality checks on a table.
